result.instructions: Tools for STEL Order, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which clients have unpaid invoice receipts that were due before today?"; "Show the sales orders created this week and their status."; "What stock movements did we have in the main warehouse last month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes STEL Order data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run stelorder_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run stelorder_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run stelorder_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. stelorder_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: stelorder_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get the STEL Order company of this APIKEY: legal name, tax number, plan, subscription status, currency and time zone. Good first call. API: GET /app/company. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

tools.name: stelorder_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients (customers) with their reference, legal name, tax number, contact details and rate. Filter by name, email, tax number or last change time. API: GET /app/clients. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

legal_name.description: Legal name filter. Use 'in:a,b' to match several.

name.description: Name filter. Use 'in:a,b' to match any of several names.

external_id.description: Your own id for the client (external id) filter.

utc_last_modification_date.description: Only items modified since this UTC time, for example 2025-01-15T00:00:00+0000.

sort.description: Sort clause, for example 'name:asc,reference:desc'. Sortable fields are listed in the vendor API reference.

start.description: Item offset: start 100 with limit 100 returns the second page.

tools.name: stelorder_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: WRITE: create one client in STEL Order. Only legal_name is required. Creates a new record in the customer's account. API: POST /app/clients. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

external_id.description: Your own id for the client.

rate_id.description: Id of an existing rate in STEL Order.

tools.name: stelorder_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one existing client. Fields you leave out keep their values. Setting a field changes the live client record. API: PUT /app/clients/{ID}. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

client_id.description: The client id to change (from stelorder_list_clients).

tools.name: stelorder_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: create one contact (a person) in STEL Order, optionally linked to a client with account_id. API: POST /app/contacts. Usage limits: 60 calls per minute per key, and 300 (Lite), 1000 (Business) or 2000 (Pro) calls per day.

external_id.description: Your own id for the contact.

account_id.description: Client id to link the contact to.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with STEL Order
prompts.description: What you can do with STEL Order here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_unpaid_invoice_receipts_that_are_due
prompts.title: Find unpaid invoice receipts that are due
prompts.description: The AI lists ordinary invoice receipts that are not paid and whose payment term date has passed. You see the client, the concept and the amount of each open item.

prompts.name: review_sales_orders_and_estimates
prompts.title: Review sales orders and estimates
prompts.description: The AI lists sales estimates and sales orders by date range, client or document state. It shows references, titles and dates.

prompts.name: check_stock_movements_and_warehouses
prompts.title: Check stock movements and warehouses
prompts.description: The AI lists warehouses and stock movements for a product or a warehouse. You see stock in, stock out and transfers with the stock before and after each movement.

prompts.name: add_a_new_client_and_contact
prompts.title: Add a new client and contact
prompts.description: The AI creates a client and a contact from details you give it, and updates the fields of an existing client. It does not delete records and does not send documents.
